system.db.name: system
system.db.schema: CREATE TABLE system ( _id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, database_class INTEGER NOT NULL, part_number TEXT, version INTEGER NOT NULL, description TEXT, copyright TEXT, file_path TEXT NOT NULL, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, create_time INTEGER)

pre.db.name: schema_version
pre.db.schema: CREATE TABLE schema_version( _id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, schema_version_num INTEGER NOT NULL)

pre.db.name: history
pre.db.schema: CREATE TABLE history( _id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, start_time INTEGER NOT NULL, start_lat INTEGER NOT NULL, start_lon INTEGER NOT NULL, end_lat INTEGER, end_lon INTEGER, end_name TEXT, end_time INTEGER)

pre.db.name: prediction
pre.db.schema: CREATE TABLE prediction( _id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, create_time INTEGER NOT NULL, start_day_of_week INTEGER NOT NULL, start_tod INTEGER NOT NULL, start_lat INTEGER NOT NULL, start_lon INTEGER NOT NULL, start_time_range INTEGER NOT NULL, start_dist_range INTEGER NOT NULL, end_lat INTEGER NOT NULL, end_lon INTEGER NOT NULL, end_name TEXT NOT NULL, destination_success INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, route_success INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL)

pre.db.name: history_rtree
pre.db.schema: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE history_rtree USING RTREE( _id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, lat_min INTEGER NOT NULL, lat_max INTEGER NOT NULL, lon_min INTEGER NOT NULL, lon_max INTEGER NOT NULL, start_min_tod INTEGER NOT NULL, start_max_tod INTEGER NOT NULL)

pre.db.name: history_rtree_node
pre.db.schema: CREATE TABLE "history_rtree_node"(nodeno INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, data BLOB)

pre.db.name: history_rtree_rowid
pre.db.schema: CREATE TABLE "history_rtree_rowid"(rowid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, nodeno INTEGER)

pre.db.name: history_rtree_parent
pre.db.schema: CREATE TABLE "history_rtree_parent"(nodeno INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, parentnode INTEGER)

custom_mm_icons.db.name: garmin_metadata
custom_mm_icons.db.schema: CREATE TABLE garmin_metadata( _id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, part_number TEXT, database_class INTEGER, version INTEGER, description TEXT, copyright TEXT, schema_version INTEGER, create_timestamp TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

custom_mm_icons.db.name: custom_table
custom_mm_icons.db.schema: CREATE TABLE custom_table ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, icon INTEGER, size INTEGER )
